name: New NMEA AIS Decoder - Vessel Location

observedProperties.label: Report Description
observedProperties.description: Describes the report based on the Message Id provided

observedProperties.label: Repeat Indicator
observedProperties.description: Used by the repeater to indicate how many times a message has been repeated; 0-3; 0 = default

observedProperties.label: Speed Over Ground
observedProperties.description: Speed over ground in knots (0–102.2 knots; 102.3 = not available)

observedProperties.label: Position Accuracy
observedProperties.description: true = high (<=10 m); false = low (>10 m) = default

observedProperties.label: Course Over Ground
observedProperties.description: Course over ground in tenths of a degree (0–359.9); 360 = not available = default

observedProperties.label: UTC Second
observedProperties.description: UTC second when report was generated by the EPFS (0-59); 60 = not available (default); 61 = manual input mode; 62 = dead reckoning mode; 63 = positioning system inoperative

observedProperties.label: Receiver Autonomous Integrity Monitoring
observedProperties.description: false = RAIM not in use; true = RAIM in use

observedProperties.label: Rate of Turn
observedProperties.description: Rate of turn: (-) = turning left, (+) = turning right; null = not available; ±10 = >±10 deg/min (no TI)

observedProperties.label: Rate of Turn Indicator
observedProperties.description: Indicates whether an external Rate of Turn Indicator is available

observedProperties.label: Special Maneuver Indicator
observedProperties.description: Special Maneuver Indicator per ITU-R M.1371-5

observedProperties.label: Navigational Status
observedProperties.description: Navigational status per ITU-R M.1371-5 Table 3
